data.title: kadence — strategy
body: # kadence — strategy
- **Date:** 2026-09-16 · **Horizon:** to 2027-01-18 (the kill-clock review), with 1.0 beyond it
- **Status:** the one strategy document. Every target here is a **target, not a measurement** — as of today: 0 messages sent, 0 interviews, 0 pilots, 0 external users.

- **Replaces:** [gtm-first-users](gtm-first-users.md) · [positioning](DOC-29) · [roadmap](DOC-33) · [north-star](DOC-27) · [lean-canvas](DOC-26) · [prioritization](DOC-30) · [discovery-2026-09](DOC-23) · the strategy prose in [plan-to-1.0](../../tasks/plan-to-1.0.md). Those stay as history; where they disagree with this file, this file wins.

- **Does not replace:** [roadmap-to-1.0](DOC-32) for the detail of gates G1–G7, ecosystem and money · [plan-to-1.0](../../tasks/plan-to-1.0.md) for task numbers and acceptance criteria · everything in `docs/research/` and `docs/decisions/`, which is evidence.

- **Operational kit:** [probe-b-outreach.md](../research/probe-b-outreach.md) (every message) · [probe-b-candidates.md](../research/probe-b-candidates.md) (the first named pool) · [interview-script.md](DOC-49) · [probe-b-results.md](DOC-56)

- **Method:** five skill-driven passes run in parallel and merged here — inventory of 21 documents; `gtm-icp` + `gtm-acquisition-channels` (platform limits checked on the web, 2026-09-16); `copywriting` + `research-interview-script`; `product-okrs` + `product-north-star-metric` + `product-outcome-roadmap`; the advisors `research-pol-probe-advisor` + `research-pre-mortem` + `research-identify-assumptions`.
## 0. The one paragraph

The architecture is measured; the bet is not. Teams of 3–8 who work with coding agents may or may not lose enough context between sessions to keep a journal for it — nobody outside the author has been asked. **For the next five weeks the strategy is one activity: the owner writes to people directly, by hand, and listens.** Everything else — pilots, the article, one Show HN, the skill package, importers, 1.0 — is sequenced behind what those conversations say, and each has a gate with a date. Between 2026-09-08 and 2026-09-16 the repository got 27 commits and zero messages went out; the plan below is built so that cannot silently happen again.
## 1. Where we play
### Positioning (carried unchanged)

> For teams of 3–8 developers who work with AI agents and keep work next to code, kadence is a journal of the team's work in the repository that keeps tasks, their full history and time spent as immutable events beside the code — so context is not lost between sessions, does not conflict on merge, and shows what the work cost. Unlike Spec Kit, Beads and Backlog.md, which store mutable state, kadence stores events.
- **Category:** shared context of a team and its agents, in the repo. Not "a git-native tracker", not spec-driven development.
- **Sharpened by the discovery verdict:** *for repositories where more than one human, or more than one agent vendor, works.*
- **Velocity and reports:** present, not advertised. In no headline.
- **Drift wording:** "the board cannot drift from the journal" — and say the limit: *it only knows what gets written to it* ([tech-lead feedback](../research/tech-lead-feedback-2026-09-10.md)).
### Ideal customer
| | Definition |
| **Account** | Product company or agency, **3–8 developers** on shared repositories (company of ~5–60). ≥ 2 use Claude Code, Cursor or Codex daily. Ukraine, Poland/EU, or English-speaking remote |

| **Person** | P1 tech lead / staff or senior / founding engineer — writes `CLAUDE.md`, can add `.kadence/` alone · P2 CTO or head of engineering under 30 people · P3 engineering manager — ask for an intro, don't pitch |

| **Job** | When I start an agent session on work someone else started, I want the agent to already know what was tried, decided and blocked, so I don't re-explain and it doesn't repeat a rejected path |
| **Triggers** | team went from 1 to 3 agent users · a new hire onboarded · a rejected approach came back · `CLAUDE.md` passed ~200 lines · Beads' Dolt migration · a Backlog.md ID collision |
| **Not for** | solo developers · > 20 developers asking for SSO · Jira/Linear mandate with nothing in the repo · no daily agent use · no Node ≥ 20 (until a binary) |

**Score before the first touch — send only at ≥ 3:** public complaint about context loss or Beads/Backlog.md pain **+3** · repo with `.beads/`, `backlog/`, `AGENTS.md`/`CLAUDE.md` or `docs/decisions/` **+2** · wrote about an agent workflow in the last 60 days **+2** · title P1/P2 with a visible team of 3–8 **+1** · UA/PL/EU time zone **+1** · large company or no team **−3**.

**After an interview — pilot if ≥ 5 of 7:** 3–8 devs · ≥ 2 daily agent users · `CLAUDE.md`/`AGENTS.md` or a work-in-repo file exists · a lead who can add a directory · **a dated story in the last 90 days** · **a workaround they already do** · Node ≥ 20.
### The three doors, in order of evidence
1. **Agent-using teams via direct outreach** — the beachhead for discovery and pilots.
2. **Beads leavers and Backlog.md teams** — stated their pain in public; the switcher path, opened by an importer only if the gate in §4 says so.
3. **Multi-vendor teams** — Claude Code + Cursor + Codex in one repo; reached through `AGENTS.md`, the skill package and the article.
### The product the ICP meets

Reviewed 2026-09-16 in [product-icp-fit-2026-09.md](DOC-31) against the product at 0.4.1 plus unreleased work; companion updates: [PRD v2](DOC-2), [story map](DOC-34), [value proposition canvas](DOC-62), [feature gap](DOC-47), [competitive snapshot](DOC-41), [JTBD](DOC-50), [landing copy](DOC-25).

- **Fact.** ~60 user-facing capabilities; the activation path the North Star measures (`init` → task or decision → an agent reads it via `prime` → a second author writes) uses **16**. All 8 capabilities rated noise for the buyer serve a manager persona; 6 of them arrived in 0.4 or are unreleased.

- **Fact.** The first run still reads as a sprint tracker: `prime` opens with "No active sprint.", the first `task add` warns about velocity, the README's first example is `sprint create … sprint close`, and the `AGENTS.md`/`CLAUDE.md` section teaches reading but never `decision add`, `note` or `claim`.

- **Fact.** Beads v1.3.0 (2026-09-15) added its own events journal, local and never pushed. What remains ours alone: history that is versioned and pushed with the code and returns with `git checkout`, with nothing to run.
**Consequences for this strategy:**
1. **Report freeze until the Oct 19 verdict** — no new analytics, and no release whose notes lead with burndown, velocity, workload or HTML reports. They stay, present and not advertised.

2. **0.5 is the second-author release**, cut by **Nov 6** so the Nov 13 self-serve test and the Nov 17 Show HN run on it: the teammate path (`npx` fallback when `kadence` is missing on their machine), the init section teaching `decision add --why`, `note` and `claim`, a first run that leads with context instead of sprints, `schema --json` listing every shipped command, and documented removal. Each item is S; order and sizes in the fit document §3–§4.
3. **Publish the `decision add --rejected` fix before Pilot 0 (Sep 25)** — the crash is fixed only in the working tree.
4. Engineering for 0.5 stays outside GTM hours and behind the "send before code" rule (§5).
## 2. Motion: outreach first

**Founder-led direct outreach → concierge pilots → product-led spread inside the team.** ACV is $0: no sales, no paid, no campaigns. The second author is recruited by the first, because `.kadence/` lives in the shared repo — that is the only built-in loop, and the North Star measures exactly it.
### Channels
Cost is **owner-minutes per booked interview**, not money. Every rate is an assumption until the Dec 14 review replaces it with measured numbers.
| # | Channel | Touches / week (Sep 17 – Oct 16) | Assumed yield | Test | Kill / scale |

| **O1** | **Public-pain authors** — Beads/Backlog.md issue authors, Probe A maintainers, new GitHub finds. Reached through **their own site, LinkedIn or X — never an email taken from GitHub** | 10 | reply 10–20%, booked ~8% of touches | ≥ 2 booked / 25 touches | < 1 / 25 → stop, pool is cold · ≥ 3 → find 20 more via GitHub search |

| **O2** | **Ukrainian warm and community DMs** — 2nd-degree contacts, DOU commenters, Telegram members who posted about agents | 8 | reply ~30%, booked ~12% | ≥ 2 / 15 | < 1 / 15 → rely on the DOU post · ≥ 3 → ask each interviewee for 2 intros |

| **O3** | **LinkedIn, signal-based** — comment on their agent post → connect → message after accept | 15 | accept 20–35% × reply 15–25% × book 50% ≈ 3–5% | ≥ 1 / 30 · accept ≥ 10% over 50 invites | 0 / 40 or accept < 10% → stop, re-target · ≥ 2 / 30 → consider the Sales Navigator trial |
| **O4** | **X, dev.to, HN comments** — public reply first; DM only if DMs are open or they follow back | 5 | ~4% | ≥ 1 / 25 | 0 / 25 → public replies only |

| **O5** | **Community posts** — DOU + one Telegram channel (research ask, no product link) | 1 post, once | ≥ 3 bookings in 7 days | as stated | < 3 → one more Telegram post with a named audience, not DOU again |
| **O6** | **Referrals** — last question of every interview | every call | 1 intro per 3 calls | as stated | always keep |
| **O7** | **Site "Book thirty minutes"** | passive | any booking | 12 weeks | cannot be killed; zero is data |
**Opened later, behind gates (§4):** C5 article + one Show HN · C6 skill package in the marketplaces that list Beads · C7 `/compare/backlog-md` and `/from-beads` pages, only once the importer exists.
### Where to find people (run by hand)
| Platform | Queries |
| LinkedIn posts, past month | `"CLAUDE.md" AND (team OR teammates)` · `"AGENTS.md"` · `"Claude Code" AND (context OR memory OR "new session")` · `"Cursor rules" AND team` |

| LinkedIn people | `("tech lead" OR "staff engineer" OR "founding engineer" OR CTO OR "head of engineering") AND ("Claude Code" OR Cursor OR "AI agents" OR agentic)` · Ukraine / Poland / EU · check company size on the company page |

| GitHub | code: `path:.beads/issues.jsonl` · `path:backlog/config.yml` · `path:AGENTS.md "Claude Code"` — org repos with ≥ 3 contributors in 30 days · issues: `repo:gastownhall/beads is:issue dolt` · `repo:MrLesk/Backlog.md is:issue (conflict OR collision)` |
| X | `"CLAUDE.md" (team OR teammate) since:2026-07-01 -filter:replies` · `beads dolt since:2026-07-01` · `"claude code" (forgets OR "new session") team` |

| Reddit / HN / blogs | r/ClaudeAI, r/cursor, r/ExperiencedDevs threads · hn.algolia.com comments `CLAUDE.md team` · dev.to/Hashnode `"agent memory"`, `"AGENTS.md" team` — **public replies only**; DM only if they ask |
| DOU / Telegram | DOU search `Claude Code`, `Cursor`, `AI-агент`; authors of substantive comments |
### Platform limits (checked 2026-09-16; LinkedIn publishes none of its numbers)

- **LinkedIn free:** ~100 invitations/week; only **~5–10 personalised notes a month**, 200 characters (300 on Premium). → Invite most people **without** a note, message after accept; spend notes on the +3 public-pain people. ≤ 20 sends a day.
- **LinkedIn terms forbid automation, scrapers and extensions.** Everything by hand.
- **Sales Navigator** ($119.99/month, 30-day trial): not before O3 books ≥ 2 from 30 touches and a list of ≥ 40 people scores ≥ 3. Cancel before renewal.
- **X:** cold DMs from unverified accounts are effectively dropped unless the recipient's DMs are open.
- **Reddit, Discord, Cursor forum, HN:** unsolicited DMs are spam by their rules. Contribute publicly first.
- **GitHub Acceptable Use Policy §7:** no unsolicited email using information taken from GitHub. → Candidates whose only contact is a GitHub-profile email are reached elsewhere or skipped.
### Messages

Full library in [probe-b-outreach.md](../research/probe-b-outreach.md): connection notes (≤ 200 / ≤ 300), DM after accept, InMail, X, Reddit/Discord, email, Telegram/DOU — EN and UA — plus four trigger hooks, pilot offer, day-14 check-in, article share, the teammate nudge, and reply handling.
**Every message obeys:**
1. Quote *their* words. Never say "context loss", "journal" or "drift" first.
2. Disclose "I build developer tooling in this area"; do not name kadence until their stories are told.
3. Ask about the last time, what they did next, what they use now. Never "would you use".
4. 30 minutes for an interview, 20 for a pilot install; one booking link.
5. **Follow-ups:** cold contacts — none. Warm or 2nd-degree contacts — one bump after 7 days of silence *(proposed; owner to confirm, §7)*. "Not now" is permanent.
6. If you cannot fill the personal line honestly, do not send.
## 3. Objectives and SMART key results

North Star, unchanged: **repositories whose `.kadence/events` holds entries from ≥ 2 authors 14 days after `init`.** No telemetry, ever — observed through public repositories (`north-star.mjs`), consented pilot check-ins, cookie-less site clicks and npm downloads — **not a signal**: 586 downloads on 2026-09-01…15 with zero known users, spiking on publish days (185 on 09-09, 198 on 09-13), so mirrors and bots dominate. Recorded, never used for a decision.
**O1. Get an honest answer about context loss from people we don't control.**
| KR | Specific + measurable | Target | By | Why achievable |
| 1.1 | First touches sent, counted in the outreach ledger | **≥ 40**, then ≥ 35/week | Sep 22 → Oct 16 | ~6.5 min/touch; §5 hours |
| 1.2 | Interviews held by the script, notes in `probe-b-results.md` within 30 min | **≥ 5** (stretch 7) | Oct 16 | ~190 touches × blended ~4% booked × 80% show ≈ 6 |
| 1.3 | Verdict published: share naming context loss unprompted, share with a workaround, "we named it first" = 0; the site's honest-status block updated | published | **Oct 19** | 3 h of synthesis |
*Relevant to:* G1 (five conversations), G2, and it starts the kill clock.
**O2. Make the North Star observable before anyone arrives.**
| KR | Measurable | Target | By |
| 2.1 | `scripts/north-star.mjs` exists; first line in `north-star-log.md` (T54) | 1 line | Sep 30 |
| 2.2 | One log line every week, no gaps | 16 lines | Jan 18 |
| 2.3 | Day-14 check-in used for every pilot (consented: authors, event count) | 100% | from first pilot |
**O3. Watch a team we don't control reach a second author without us in the room.**
| KR | Measurable | Target | By | Math |
| 3.1 | Pilot 0 at the workplace: `init` on a screen share, hesitations logged | done | Sep 25 | 1.5 h |
| 3.2 | Concierge installs in teams we don't control, in `north-star-log.md` | **≥ 3** | Nov 6 | ~11 interviews × 30% qualify × 60% accept ≈ 2, + the 2026-09-10 tech lead |
| 3.3 | Pilots with a second author at day 14, without being asked | **≥ 2 of 3** | Nov 13 | 50% × 3–4 pilots |
| 3.4 | Self-serve test: README only, owner silent — reach `task add` and an agent running `prime` in ≤ 10 min | **4 of 5** people | Nov 13 | 5 × 20 min |
| 3.5 | First-run fixes shipped from pilot hesitations | ≥ 3 | Nov 13 | engineering hours, outside GTM |
**O4. Earn attention with measured numbers, not a pitch.**
| KR | Measurable | Target | By |
| 4.1 | Article on the site; every number from `facts.json`; read by a native speaker | published | Nov 13 |
| 4.2 | **One** Show HN (Tue–Thu, US morning); 72-hour numbers in `channel-tests.md` | posted Nov 17 | Nov 20 |
| 4.3 | Install-command copies ÷ site visits, 7 days after the post | ≥ 5% (floor: > 30 visits in 48 h) | Nov 24 |
| 4.4 | Unsolicited inbound: issues, questions, bookings | ≥ 3 | Dec 4 |
| 4.5 | Ukrainian long-form on DOU (the article + anonymised findings) | published | Dec 4 |
| 4.6 | Article shared one-to-one with people who discussed the topic (Stage 3 message) | ≥ 20 | Dec 4 |
**O5. Be where agents look.**
| KR | Measurable | Target | By |
| 5.1 | `SKILL.md` (≤ 60 lines) listed in marketplaces that list Beads | 2 | Nov 6 |
| 5.2 | An install count > 0 or a mention in someone else's `AGENTS.md` | ≥ 1 | Jan 8 |
### Next, conditional — P4 Switchers · 2026-11-23 → 2027-01-15
Runs only if the Oct 19 gate says migration is a channel.
**O6. Make switching a decision, not a project.**
| KR | Measurable | Target | By |
| 6.1 | `/from-beads` fake door ("migrate with me, 30 min") linked from switcher conversations and the article | ≥ 2 bookings | Nov 9 — **no bookings → T68 moves to Later** |
| 6.2 | Backlog.md importer (T67) in 0.6, tested on a real Probe A fixture | shipped | Dec 11 |
| 6.3 | Switcher touches: Probe A maintainers not yet contacted + people naming Backlog.md/Beads | 60 | Dec 18 |
| 6.4 | Switcher conversations | ≥ 3 | Dec 23 |
| 6.5 | A team we don't control imports and has a second author at day 14 | ≥ 1 | Jan 15 |
### Later — P5 Decide · 2027-01-18
**O7. Decide on evidence, not fatigue.**
| KR | Measurable | Target | By |
| 7.1 | Repositories with ≥ 2 authors at day 14, all sources | **≥ 2, including ≥ 1 public** | Jan 18 |
| 7.2 | Visible inits (public `.kadence/` + consented pilots; npm excluded, see §3) vs the kill threshold of 20 | recorded | Jan 18 |
| 7.3 | Evidence table for G1–G7 and the kill-criteria verdict | written | Jan 18 |

**G1 is not lowered and not expected in this horizon.** Five public repositories with two authors needs ~9 external pilots, ~45 interviews, ~600 touches — outreach alone lands mid-January at best, and the beachhead builds in private. Realistic G1, via switchers and inbound on top of outreach: **Q2 2027**. 1.0 follows G1; the seven gates are in [roadmap-to-1.0 §2](DOC-32).
## 4. Decision gates
Each gate has a date and three written outcomes, so none is decided by silence.
| Date | Gate | Go | Adjust | Stop |

| **Tue Sep 22** | Execution | ≥ 40 touches **and** ≥ 2 booked; paragraph on why not five | < 2 booked → move 10 of next week's cold slots to warm referral asks | **< 20 touches → an execution failure, not a market answer. Feature work freezes until 40 are sent** |
| **Fri Oct 9** | Discovery pace | held + booked ≥ 5 | < 5 → extend to Oct 30, verdict Nov 2, every later date moves 14 days. Never lower n | — |

| **Mon Oct 19** | Probe B verdict | ≥ 60% of ≥ 5 interviews tell a dated context-loss story unprompted, **and** ≥ 3 show a workaround → shared-context positioning holds | 1–2 of 5 → lead with conflict-freedom for switchers; door 2 becomes the main path | 0 stories and 0 workarounds → Next shrinks to importers only; the clock still starts |
| same | Importers | ≥ 2 interviewees on a file tracker describe what switching would cost → P4 runs | — | otherwise T67/T68 → Later, C7 dropped |
| **Fri Nov 13** | Pilots | ≥ 2 of 3 have a second author **and** self-serve 4 of 5 → Show HN Nov 17 | 1 of 3 → more pilots; HN Dec 1–3 | 0 of 3 → no HN; the first run is the product problem |
| **Fri Nov 20** | Public proof | > 30 visits, ≥ 5% copies, ≥ 1 inbound | below → the message is wrong, not the channel; rewrite from interview quotes. **No repost** | — |
| **Mon Dec 14** | Funnel re-base | measured rates replace every assumption in §2 and §3 | cold LinkedIn < 1 booking per 100 invites → budget moves to warm, referral and switcher pools | — |

| **Mon Jan 18, 2027** | Kill clock (90 days after the verdict) | any one of the four criteria false → continue; 1.0 gates re-planned | only "nobody named context loss" true → narrower product | all four true (< 20 visible inits · 0 public second-author repos · 0 inbound · nobody named context loss unprompted) → README says "finished portfolio piece" |
## 5. Operating rhythm
### Hours
| Period | GTM hours / week | Of which |
| **Sprint, Sep 17 – Oct 16** | **8** (cap) — see §7 for the 10-hour option | touches 4 · interviews 2.5 · list-building 1 · review 0.5 |
| Pilots and proof, Oct 17 – Dec 4 | 6–8 | 20+ touches · 1 interview · pilot check-ins · article |
| Switchers, Dec 5 – Jan 15 | 5–6 | 15 switcher touches · calls |
| Holidays, Dec 21 – Jan 3 | floor of 10 touches, not a miss | — |
Engineering is outside these hours. Overrun sheds, in order: O4 → C7 pages → the DOU long-form. Never a conversation.
### The week
| When | What |
| **Mon, 60 min** | Scorecard (below), three lines in `channel-tests.md`: what moved, what did not, the one thing this week. Build the week's list: 40–50 names scoring ≥ 3 |
| **Tue / Wed / Thu, 60–80 min** | One batch of 12–15 touches: read their material 3 min → one line only they could receive → send by hand. LinkedIn comments before invites |
| Any day | Interviews at their slot; notes within 30 minutes; ask for a referral |
| **Fri, 30 min** | Answer every reply; mark silence `no reply` after 7 days; update counts |

**Send before code:** no commit to `src/` on a day with fewer than 3 touches sent. *Lifted by the owner on 2026-09-16 for the 0.5 second-author release only (T105–T118, T54): the release is built now so pilots and outreach run on it. The rule stands for everything else.* A week with more `src/` commits than touches is a red line on Monday's scorecard.
### Scorecard (Monday, 30 minutes)
| # | Metric | Source | Weekly target | Phase target | Now |
| 1 | Touches sent | ledger | ≥ 35 (P1) · ≥ 20 (after) | 190 by Oct 16 | 0 |
| 2 | LinkedIn accept rate | ledger | ≥ 20% (floor 10%) | — | — |
| 3 | Replies ÷ touches, per channel and per hook | ledger | O1 ≥ 10% · O2 ≥ 30% · O3 ≥ 4% | — | — |
| 4 | Booked ÷ replies | ledger | ≥ 50% | — | — |
| 5 | Interviews held · with a dated story · with a workaround | `probe-b-results.md` | 1.5 (P1) · 1 (P2) | ≥ 5 by Oct 16 | 0 |
| 6 | **We named the problem first** | same | **0** | 0 | 0 |
| 7 | Pilots installed · second author at day 14 | `north-star-log.md` | — | 3 by Nov 6 · 2 of 3 by Nov 13 | 0 |
| 8 | **North Star** (consented / public) | log + `north-star.mjs` | one line | ≥ 2 incl. ≥ 1 public by Jan 18 | 0 / 0 |
| 9 | Copies ÷ visits · booking clicks | site | recorded | ≥ 5% by Nov 24 | — |
| 10 | npm downloads, 30 days | npm API | recorded, not a signal | — | 586 (Sep 1–15, publish spikes) |
| 11 | Inbound (issues, questions, bookings) | GitHub, calendar | recorded | ≥ 3 by Dec 4 | 0 |
| 12 | `src/` commits vs touches | git log, ledger | touches ≥ commits | — | 27 vs 0 (Sep 8–16) |
| 13 | GTM hours | calendar | ≤ 8 | — | — |
| 14 | Next gate | §4 | — | — | Sep 22 |
### The ledger
A CSV **outside git**, e.g. `~/kadence-outreach/outreach.csv`:

`id, first_touch, platform, channel (O1–O7), profile_url, signal_link, tier, score, hook (T1–T4), status (to send / sent / replied / booked / done / declined / no reply / opted out), booked_at, showed, story, workaround, referral, pilot (offered / accepted / declined), notes`

Only counts go into the repository (`channel-tests.md`, a `kadence note`). **Never put a person in the kadence journal** — it is append-only, so someone who asks to be removed could never be erased. Delete a row on request; delete all rows 90 days after the study.
## 6. Outreach is also the probe
The advisors' ranking (Risk = Impact × (1 − Confidence)), refreshed from the [2026-09-02 map](DOC-39):
| # | Assumption | Risk | Probe | Pass | Fail → |

| N1 | **The owner sends every week, not in bursts** | **8.0** | ledger count | ≥ 15 touches/week to Sep 29, ≥ 10 after | < 10 in any two weeks → `src/` freeze; again → name the project a portfolio piece |
| B | Multi-author / multi-vendor teams lose enough context to keep a journal | **8.0** | Probe B interviews | gate Oct 19 | narrow to switchers |
| N2 | A second author appears without the owner pushing | 7.2 | concierge pilots | 2 of 3 at day 14 | first-run becomes the 0.5 priority; no HN |
| N3 | Direct outreach reaches the ICP and gets replies | 6.4 | hook test below | a hook ≥ 15% reply | all < 5% after 60 → move hours to warm and community |
| F | A stranger gets from README to a working journal alone | 5.6 | self-serve test | 4 of 5 | fix before HN |
| E | Beads and Backlog.md users would switch, not just complain | 4.0 | `/from-beads` fake door | ≥ 2 bookings | importers → Later |
Retired from the old map: sprints and velocity as a pull (no requests across 1 076 Beads issues), file access vs MCP (answered by Probe C). Conflicts stay as proof, not pitch.
**The hook test (O3/O4 general pool only; O1 always gets its own trigger):** three hooks rotated in send order, 20 touches each —
**A** "when a second person or another agent picks up the work, how do they find out what was decided?" ·
**B** "have two branches ever edited or numbered the same task?" ·
**C** "tried keeping tasks in the repo and stopped?"

Same length, same disclosure, same ask. Measure **reply rate, booked rate and story rate** per hook. A hook wins at ≥ 15% reply, ≥ 2× the next, ≥ 5 replies — it becomes the article and HN lead. Anything closer is a direction, and the synthesis says so. An interviewee's context loss counts as *unprompted* only if it differs from the hook they answered, or comes with a dated incident.
## 7. Decisions the owner still has to make

1. **The 10-hour sprint.** Outreach-heavy discovery needs ~10 h/week to hold 5 interviews by Oct 5; at the 8-hour cap the targets above (≥ 5 by Oct 16, verdict Oct 19) hold instead. Choose one and write it down.

2. **The Sep 22 gate is reframed**, from "five booked" to "≥ 40 touches and ≥ 2 booked". Seven days from a first touch to a call makes five impossible from a standing start on Sep 16. Confirm, or keep the original and write the reason on the 22nd.
3. **One follow-up for warm contacts** — the old rule was "no follow-up to anyone". Proposed: cold none, warm one after 7 days.
4. **`probe-b-candidates.md` out of git before the next push.** It names real people; statuses like `declined` are about them. The ledger replaces it.
5. **What a "no" from Probe B does to the project.** The pre-mortem's elephant: if it is not decided now, January's fatigue decides it. The default on record is §4's Oct 19 row and the kill clock.
6. **Whether this needs a second person who likes talking to users.** Fourteen days of avoided outreach is the evidence the question exists.
## 8. Rules that do not bend
- No telemetry, no network in the core, no account. $0, MIT, forever; the format is never gated; sponsorship only at 1.0.
- No messages in competitors' issue trackers. No email harvested from GitHub. No automation on any social network.
- No speed claims until `probe-e-results.md` exists. No "used by" until `north-star-log.md` has a real repository. Stars recorded, never targeted.
- One launch post — Show HN. DOU is research recruiting and the Ukrainian long-form, measured separately; neither is a second launch.
- kadence unnamed in an interview until the stories are told. Counter-metric: **0**.
- Never "Beads is wrong". Beads proved the category.
- Not building: web server, hosted core, two-way sync, time tracking, editor extensions, `llms.txt`, `kadence context`. MCP only when a named user cannot run the CLI.
## 9. Pre-mortem — "It is 2027-01-18 and the go-to-market failed"
| Tiger | Early warning | Mitigation | Check by |
